text: Rory Mensah scored a stunning long-range goal to bring Redmond Rovers back on level terms at 1-1 against Ironvale Athletic. The move started from a free kick and included six quick passes over 20 seconds, showing Redmond’s skill in keeping the ball and breaking down Ironvale’s tough defense. Kian Coleman set Mensah up with a clever pass, and despite the shot being from 26 meters with a very low chance of scoring normally (xG 0.016), Mensah’s strike beat the keeper. This goal reflects Redmond’s strong control and pressure in the game so far[#37'] [#690].
